class.name: NetwDatabaseBackend

method.name: _delete_slot
method.description: Removes [param slot], and resolves an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. Failed cleanup must stay discoverable and retryable rather than reporting success. [param session] is the [NetwMultiplayer] asking. [method NetwDatabase.delete_slot] settles with what this answers. [codeblock lang=text] this promise NetwDatabase.delete_slot settles with ┠╴resolves an Error that Error ┠╴rejects the reject's code ┖╴is null ERR_INVALID_DATA [/codeblock]

method.name: _list_slots
method.description: Resolves a [PackedStringArray] of every slot this storage holds. Read it from storage, so a slot written by an earlier run appears. [param session] is the [NetwMultiplayer] asking. [method NetwDatabase.list_slots] builds its reply from what this answers. [codeblock lang=text] this promise the reply's error ┠╴resolves a PackedStringArray OK, and the array becomes slots ┠╴resolves anything else ERR_INVALID_DATA ┠╴rejects the reject's code, and its detail becomes detail ┖╴is null ERR_INVALID_DATA [/codeblock]

method.name: _open
method.description: Resolves a fresh [NetwDatabaseConnection] over [param slot], or rejects with why it could not. Build a new connection every time, rather than handing back one that was already open. [param session] is the [NetwMultiplayer] opening the slot. [method NetwDatabase.open] settles with what this answers, and the database stays closed on any answer but a connection. [codeblock lang=text] this promise NetwDatabase.open settles with ┠╴resolves a connection OK ┠╴resolves anything else ERR_CANT_CREATE ┠╴rejects the reject's code and detail ┖╴is null ERR_INVALID_DATA [/codeblock]

method.name: delete_slot_default
method.description: The stock [method _delete_slot], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _delete_slot] calls this to reach it.

method.name: list_slots_default
method.description: The stock [method _list_slots], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _list_slots] calls this to reach it.

method.name: open_default
method.description: The stock [method _open], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _open] calls this to reach it.
